# RawStorageEvaluation

## Purpose and entry points
- Owns the GE001 raw storage correctness/generated-consumer composite; entry action.yml under BenchmarkComparisons/ADR-066.

## Boundaries
- Read root/workflow policy, GarnetStorageEvaluation feature and frozen GE001 contract before editing.
- Closed correctness/benchmark modes only. Correctness executes real TUnit normal/scalar fixtures; each benchmark runner/process selects exactly one public raw ZoneTree or Tsavorite engine.
- Preserve identical binary inputs, package/source/settings/job identity, raw BDN JSON/CSV/stdout, terminal status/bounds and strict complete8-cell gate. No fake provider/internal Garnet bridge, dropped failure, local qualification, service/RF3/durability winner or270/site result.
- Root exclusively integrates shared workflow/docs/Git/native provider evidence; preserve other source owners.

## Commands and verification
- Invoked only by benchmarks.yml in GitHub Actions. Development source/YAML review does not qualify tests or performance.
- TUnit raw source-contract/real fixture tests map AC-GE-002..005; actual generated consumer and original full JSON are required. Retain failures and artifact identity.

## Skills and protected risks
- No installed skill applies; do not install tools/skills or modify global configuration.
- Ordinary400/200/50/3 source limits remain; no analyzer suppression, package lockfile, secret output or invented measurements.
